name: Clover's Conjuring Cat-Astrophe!
source:
"Clover's Conjuring Cat-Astrophe!" is a cute, simple visual novel/puzzle hybrid game about matching up catless witches and witchless cats.

Witch-in-training Clover accidentally finds her bedroom filled with felines after a summoning gone wrong and she only has 5 days to get rid of them before room inspection! Will she manage to clear out her room in time? 

Help her to avoid getting sent to detention and have fun along the way in this short, cosy visual novel game with light puzzle elements.

[From [url=https://heartpunchstudio.itch.io/clovers-conjuring-cat-astrophe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“克洛弗的招魂猫——天文星！”是一款可爱、简单的视觉小说/益智混合游戏，关于匹配无猫女巫和无女巫猫。

受训女巫克洛弗在一次召唤失误后意外发现她的卧室里挤满了猫科动物，而在检查房间之前，她只有5天的时间消灭它们！她能及时清理房间吗？

在这款带有轻松解谜元素的简短舒适的视觉小说游戏中，帮助她避免被拘留并一路享受乐趣。

[来自[url=https://heartpunchstudio.itch.io/clovers-conjuring-cat-astrophe]itch.io[/url]]
